eval: (()=>{const R=window.__hq.renderer;let L=null;R.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.isLOD&&Math.abs(o.position.z-2125)<5&&Math.abs(o.position.x)<5)L=o;});if(!L)return 'no';const anc=[];let p=L;while(p){anc.push((p.name||p.type)+':'+p.visible);p=p.parent;}const lv=L.levels[0].object;let meshes=0,vis=0,ops=[];lv.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh){meshes++;if(m.visible)vis++;if(ops.length<3)ops.push((m.material.name||'')+':'+m.material.opacity+':'+m.material.colorWrite+':'+m.material.visible);}});return 'auto='+L.autoUpdate+' anc='+anc.join('>')+' lv0 meshes='+meshes+' vis='+vis+' mats='+ops.join(';')+' lv0vis='+lv.visible+' children='+lv.children.length})()
